title: Auditor shell and shared visual components
scope: Build officer navigation, dashboard shell and case page skeleton against the fixture contract; establish shared Frappe-inspired tokens/component showcase and first auditor queue/detail visual baseline

acceptance.text: Build officer navigation, dashboard shell and case page skeleton against the fixture contract
Run browser smoke checks for navigation, keyboard focus and loading/error/empty states
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: Run browser smoke checks for navigation, keyboard focus and loading/error/empty states

evidence.text: apps/auditor-web Vue 3 + TS + frappe-ui 1.1.0 app: sidebar navigation (Overview, Case queue, Component showcase), overview shell grouping fixture cases by review lane, case queue with search/scenario/lane filters, numeric decimal sorting and pagination, case detail skeleton (summary; Evidence/Entities/Findings tabs state 'not available in fixture mode' and cite the /api/v1 operations in integration/api/openapi.json (TAX-018), which the fixture server does not serve, rather than inventing data). Reads GET /api/cases and /api/cases/{id}; client rejects responses not marked mode=fixture/synthetic=true. Observed 2026-11-03: npm run typecheck:auditor exit 0; npm run test:auditor 28/28 passed; npm run build:auditor succeeded; served by scripts/dev.py at http://127.0.0.1:58080/auditor/.

npm run test:auditor:browser (Playwright 1.64.1, Microsoft Edge 156 channel, Windows 11): 17 tests passed, rerun with --repeat-each=2 -> 34/34 passed. Covers sidebar/breadcrumb navigation and back, lane link to filtered queue, keyboard skip link, visible focus outline and Enter-to-sort, keyboard sidebar activation, loading -> ready, unavailable service with retry recovery, non-fixture data refused, empty queue and empty filter results, 403 denied, unknown case/page, failed page chunk recovery. CI job auditor-browser added (Chromium).

Follows docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md via shared apps/shared/design tokens + preset (ADR-004). Screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-020: overview/queue/case-detail/showcase at 1440, 1024, 390px; loading, empty, no-matches, error, denied, not-found and unavailable-tab states at 1440 and 390px; skip-link and table-sort focus, button hover/focus, form validation and dialog at 1440px (Edge 156). Accessibility: axe (wcag2a/aa, wcag21aa) reports no serious/critical violations on overview, queue, case detail and showcase; no page-wide horizontal scroll at 320px width (reflow); keyboard checks as in criterion 2. CI (Linux Chromium) found badge color-contrast failures that the Edge run did not report; fixed by mapping badge text to the darker ink-*-8 tokens and re-verified: all 4 axe scans pass in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble and in Edge. Supplied for the reviewer's visual review; visual approval NOT assumed and remains with the reviewer.

Tests and evidence recorded in this task file; status set to IN_REVIEW with PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/91 (opened 2026-11-03, review requested from the area owner, not merged by the agent). Branch refreshed from main 629071e before review; all checks rerun after the merge.
